result:
The end card is built in `s5/`, and `npx hyperframes check` passes with no errors. I haven't rendered it or opened the preview.

- **Length and look:** it runs 3 s at 1920×1080 with a dark ground. "github.com/mohessaid/girth" is set in JetBrains Mono at 96 px over a mint underline.
- **Reveal:** the URL slides up out of a mask from 0 s while fading in. The underline grows across from 0.4 s, and the whole card fades out over the last 0.35 s. I looked at the 1.2 s frame and it reads cleanly.
- **Layout:** `index.html` is a root with a single host. The card is its own scene in `s5/compositions/endcard.html`, and the URL is a variable in the project.
- **Check output:** two info-level notes remain. They flag text and an element extending past the mask, which is the reveal itself.
- **Fixes along the way:** check warned that frame 0 was blank, so the text now starts partly visible. It also warned that the root should hold only scene hosts, which is why I moved the card into its own scene.

The URL is one colour. Binding it to the variable would have wiped out an accent on "mohessaid", so I dropped it.
